title: Computed load-distribution factor example
regulation_source: Formula-style static-calculation example adapted from ice-class structural-rule coefficient patterns
regulation_text: A stored engineering coefficient shall match a regulation-derived calculated value. In this example, the expected coefficient is calculated from the height of the load area h and frame spacing s using expected = 1 - 0.2 * h / s. The stored value in the ship graph must match the calculated value within a small numerical tolerance.
notes: This few-shot is intended as a static-calculation pattern example, not as a literal TRAFICOM 2021 section 4.2.1 transcription. It teaches the generator to retrieve formula inputs from the ship graph, compute an expected value using SPARQL BIND, and compare the stored engineering value against the computed value with a tolerance.
